request.spec:
When a grade has no rate in force on a date on a sheet nor on its parents, a sheet that was
cloned uses the rate of the sheet it was cloned from (and so on up that sheet's parents and
source).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
When a grade has no rate in force on a date on a sheet nor on its parents, a sheet that was
cloned uses the rate of the sheet it was cloned from (and so on up that sheet's parents and
source).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Cloned sheets now fall back to the rates of the sheet they were cloned from. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**How a rate is now found** for a grade on a date:
1. The sheet's own rates.
2. Its parents, up to three levels, as before.
3. If the sheet is a clone, the sheet it was cloned from, checked the same way: its own rates, then its parents, then its own source. This repeats up the chain, and each sheet is checked at most once, so a loop can't run forever.

**What changed:**
- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V102__sheet_source.sql`, adds a `source` column to `sheet`. When a sheet is cloned, `SheetCloner` saves the original sheet's id there. Sheets cloned before this change have no source recorded, so they don't get the fallback.
- **Server:** `Rates.ancestors` now uses a new shared helper, `Rates.chain`, which builds the list in the order above. All the server's due and rollup figures, and statements, use this list. The as-of view (`AsOfView.ancestors`) uses the same helper, with parents as they stood on the date. A clone's source never changes, so it isn't tracked by date.
- **Front end:** `rateOn` in `useRates.ts` used to stop after three inherited levels. It now checks every level the server returns, so rates from the source chain are used for the figures shown on screen.

Only the cloned sheet's own source is followed. If one of its parents happens to be a clone, that parent's source is not checked. I took this from the wording "a sheet that was cloned uses the rate of the sheet it was cloned from"; the tests don't cover it either way.
